description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a function to split a string into tokens based on spaces, returning a linked list of the tokens. It also includes internal helper functions to validate tokens and add them to the list if valid.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object containing utility functions for splitting strings into tokens and managing token validation.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the linked list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is non-empty, returning true if valid.
